A little advance notice to those of you planning on playing in the
champioships at Gen*Con:

I plan on collecting decklists from every player at the beginning
of the tournament, per section 6.3 of the V:EKN rules. So if you can,
please have your deck lists already made out ahead of time, to save
time onsite.

Thanks,
Scott
